statement_summary: Security and Privacy Lead designated in writing
Yearly risk assessment with SP 800-30; risks owned and treated
Risk acceptance authority; High risks never accepted
Sanctions recorded; good-faith reporting protected
Service providers need written terms, a current AOC where card data is involved, and a place on the provider list
Yearly independent assessment; scope confirmed every 12 months; no 'In Place' without evidence
Security records kept at least 3 years
Yearly policy review; policies available to staff
Written, risk-rated, time-limited exceptions
Named accounts; no shared Windows login or shared mailbox password
Role-based least privilege with written approval; card-display permission limited then removed
MFA for every PMS user, mailbox, portal, and administrator or remote login
Termination checklist completed by the last day; shared secrets changed
Monthly account reconciliation; role check every 6 months
15-minute device lock; no automatic sign-in on the front desk PC
Vendor remote tools off by default; per-session access with MFA or one-time code; remote access log; yearly MSP technician list
Password length; no vendor default passwords; staff Wi-Fi passphrase changed yearly and on departures
Sealed emergency PMS credential and emergency key cards
Front desk PC used only for the PMS, email, and approved sites
No guest or card data in personal accounts or public AI tools
Lock or switch accounts; never share passwords or MFA codes
Caller and visitor verification; no room numbers or guest details by phone
Training at hire and yearly with the front desk module
Report suspected incidents within 1 hour
Signed policy acknowledgment
Card compromise runbook kept and printed
Report suspected incidents within 1 hour
Log every incident
Do not power off or wipe affected devices; disconnect and stop keyed entry
Acquirer within 24 hours of suspicion; card brands per acquirer instructions
Determination date recorded; notices per the P08 matrix; written no-harm determination kept 5 years
Insurer hotline first; MSP engaged under contract
Ransom payment only with approvals and an OFAC check
Vendor breach reports logged and handled (10-day Florida agent duty)
Yearly tabletop exercise with the MSP
Lessons learned within 30 days
Three classification levels
Card data rules: terminals or pay-by-link only; nothing typed or written; no security codes; no display
Restricted data only in approved systems; remaining paper forms locked away
Inventory of devices, terminals with serial numbers, SaaS, and Restricted data locations
Weekly terminal inspection per the P2PE Instruction Manual
New vendors and tools approved before receiving data
Approved AI tools only; guest messaging add-on not switched on without assessment
Retention: register 2 years; ID scans 30 days after checkout; no card data
Cross-cut shredding; wipe or certified destruction with records
Weekly review of PMS card displays, exports, and sign-ins
Encryption; nightly backup including the lock database; immutable versions; quarterly restore test
